recommendation_note: run16 uses the v5b_sharp1023_midflat70 bank with impulse gentle fraction 0.3 for both rate families. Gate spec 6 measures square/DC-step ringing on 8x sinc-oversampled signals so the 48 kHz square rows no longer depend on output-grid phase. All three seeds pass G1-G9 (spec 6) on CPU and strict-FP32 CUDA; G5 headroom grows further, hit-time HF is closer to sharp, and isolated-impulse ringing is about -20 dB (sharp alone -15 dB).
